evidence: Caes. BG 1.14: recentium injūriārum memoriam (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Att. 8.15.2: recentissima tua est epistula Kal. data
terms.comment: “That has not long existed”, as against novus, “not there before” (Lewis & Short). Within more recent memory: recentiōre memoriā (Cic. N.D. 2.6, Lewis & Short).
The nearest in time, before or after (see last: the one before this).
A recent invention is something nūper excōgitātum (see lately).

phrases.latin: recentissima tua est epistula Kal. data, in quā optās congressum pācemque nōn dēspērās
phrases.english: your most recent letter is dated the Kalends; in it you hope for a meeting and do not despair of peace

phrases.latin: nātūrā locus jam ante praeceps recentī lāpsū terrae in pedum mīlle admodum altitūdinem abruptus erat
phrases.english: the place, steep by nature already, had been broken away by a recent landslide to a depth of nearly a thousand feet
